messages:
Ana: Heads up — new-hire conversion (Jess Park) hit backup withholding on the 03/15 payrun because we didn't have an SSN on file. Can payroll confirm? :eyes:
Mike: Do we have emp ID or email? I'll pull the run.
Ana: Jess Park, jess.park@redwood.com, emp 48321, payrun 2026-03-15. She uploaded her SSN via DocuSign on 03/18.
Mike: Pulling 03/15. System shows tax_residence=UK and no SSN in the payroll feed — that flag triggered 24% backup withholding (federal). :grimacing:
Jess: Hi all — confirmed I submitted SSN last week (last4 6789). Sorry for the mess, I thought HR sent it to payroll.
Linda: I'll open an off-cycle reversal and request a W-2c. Need manager approval to proceed with reversal. @Kevin can you approve?
Kevin: Approved. Please proceed and keep me posted.
Linda: Plan: 1) queue off-cycle reversal for 03/15 (refund backup withholding to employee), 2) re-run corrected pay with SSN, 3) submit W-2c request and tax-team notif. ETA 5-7 biz days for W-2c processing; payroll correction payment ~3-4 biz days after reversal runs.
Ana: If the 24% already hit Jess's bank (reduced net pay), how does she get that back? Is it automatic via W-2/W-2c?
Linda: Backup withholding is remitted to IRS; on the corrected W-2/W-2c the withheld amount will show and they can claim it when filing. The off-cycle reversal will restore net pay sooner; any amounts already remitted will be reconciled on the W-2/W-2c.
TaxBot: FYI — backup withholding is reported on Form 945. If SSN is added retroactively and we correct payroll, tax ops may still need to file 945 for the period and then adjust. I'll escalate to tax-ops to confirm whether a 945 amendment is required.
Mike: I'll sync with tax ops now and update this thread.
Linda: Internal note for ops: run command: ```offcycle-reverse --emp 48321 --orig-payrun 2026-03-15 --reason "SSN provided after run"``` Will attach ticket PAY-11234.
Jess: Thank you — appreciate the fast response.
Linda: Posted: off-cycle queued, awaiting manager sign-off (got it). I'll update when the payment posts and when W-2c request submitted.
Ana: Thanks everyone. Please ping if anything else needed from Jess. :pray:
